question: Who is the author of the book 'The Illicit Happiness of Other People'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manu Joseph**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Manu Joseph** is the author of the critically acclaimed novel "**The Illicit Happiness of Other People**", which was published in 2012.
 
• The book is set in Chennai, India, during the 1990s and is a blend of dark comedy, philosophy, and psychological drama.
 
• It explores themes of family dynamics, mental health, and existential questions through the life of the protagonist, Ousep Chacko, and his family.
 
• Manu Joseph is an Indian journalist and novelist, known for his sharp wit and incisive commentary in both fiction and non-fiction.
 
• His other notable works include "**Serious Men**" and "**Miss Laila, Armed and Dangerous**", which have also received critical acclaim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Janice Pariat:**

 
 
• Janice Pariat is an Indian author and poet known for her debut book "**Boats on Land**", which won the Sahitya Akademi Young Writer Award and the Crossword Book Award for Fiction.
 
• Her other works include "**Seahorse**" and "**Everything the Light Touches**".
 
• Janice's writing often explores themes of memory, culture, and the natural world, with a poetic and lyrical narrative style.
 
 
 
• **Madhuri Vijay:**
 
 
• Madhuri Vijay is an Indian author known for her debut novel "**The Far Field**", which won the JCB Prize for Literature in 2019.
 
• The book is set in Kashmir and deals with complex themes such as personal loss, political turmoil, and the search for identity.
 
• Madhuri's writing is praised for its vivid descriptions and nuanced exploration of human relationships.
 
 
 
• **Neel Mukherjee:**
 
 
• Neel Mukherjee is an Indian author recognized for his novels such as "**The Lives of Others**" and "**A State of Freedom**".
 
• "The Lives of Others" was shortlisted for the 2014 Man Booker Prize and explores the socio-economic and political changes in Bengal through the lens of a family saga.
 
• His works often deal with themes of societal inequality, migration, and the human condition.
 
 
 
• **Theme of the Question:**
 
 
• "The Illicit Happiness of Other People" delves into philosophical and existential themes, reflecting on human desires, morality, and the pursuit of happiness.
 
• The book combines elements of dark humor and tragedy, making it a unique and thought-provoking read.
